field_of_expertise.detail: PhD student studying Industrial/Organizational Psychology and Human Factors; research interest in human behavior in extreme environments (polar expeditions, military, astronauts); prior graduate work in space studies, cognitive psychology, and aviation human factors. This schema's field_of_expertise enum has no 'Human Factors' category (unlike Research Project's domain enum, which does) -- 'Psychology' used as the closest available fit; the Human Factors/I-O specialization is preserved in this detail field.
